# Portman

> Portman is a macOS-native port management tool for developers. It visualizes active TCP listeners, enables custom labeling, and integrates with AI assistants via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/): Product landing page with feature overview and download links
- [Getting Started](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/guide/getting-started): Quick start guide for desktop app and MCP server
- [What is Portman?](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/guide/what-is-portman): Overview of the problem Portman solves and its key features

## Features

- [Active Ports](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/guide/active-ports): Real-time port scanning and process detection
- [Find Free Ports](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/guide/find-free): Discover available ports in a specified range
- [Labels](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/guide/labels): Assign custom names to ports, PIDs, or command patterns

## AI Integration (MCP)

- [MCP Setup](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/mcp/setup): Configure Portman MCP with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or Antigravity
- [MCP Tools](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/mcp/tools): Available MCP tools: scan_listeners, who, ports_find, label_set, etc.

## Reference

- [FAQ](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/reference/faq): Frequently asked questions about Portman
- [Troubleshooting](https://zeroshotlog.github.io/portman/docs/reference/troubleshooting): Common issues and solutions

## Downloads & Resources

- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zeroshotlog/portman/releases): Download the desktop app (DMG for macOS)
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/portman-mcp): MCP server package (MIT licensed)

---

## Quick Facts

- **Platform**: macOS 11.0+ (Big Sur and later), Apple Silicon native
- **Components**: Desktop App (Proprietary EULA), MCP Server (MIT License)
- **Data Storage**: Local SQLite database at ~/.local/share/portman/labels.sqlite
- **No telemetry**: All data stays on your machine
